attributes.role: Data Engineering, Machine Learning and Generative AI Engineering Trainee
attributes.summary:
Improved trading strategies using financial market data from Yahoo Finance on Cryptocurrencies. This focused on understanding market trends, testing trading strategies such as back testing and creating efficient data systems using Python, SQL, data management, machine learning operations and web development. 
Engineered prompts for GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 to evaluate prompt effectiveness. 
Developed a chatbot, that revolutionized handling vast YouTube data, to convert human-like questions into SQL queries, facilitating data extraction and visualization.
Developed hugging face APIs and fine-tuned AI models to make them multilingual pros. 
Transformer models, Python programming, and using GPUs.
Analyzed digital content consumption trends to aid strategic decision-making using my skills in data analysis, Python and SQL.
Built scalable data infrastructure for NLP projects using transformer models, Python, and GPUs.
Data ingestion technique
Leveraged on Redash chatbot add-on, an LLM that revolutionizes on data exploration using Natural Language Processing (NLP) for extracting insights from Redash dashboards and databases.
Did a project using sentimental analysis, topic modelling

Spearheaded the implementation of a new Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system which enabled customers book collections and track their goods while on transit, this increased customer satisfaction by 50%. It also improved the business operational efficiency by reducing turn around times for routine tasks by over 60%.
Created and shared customer invoices with customers from the reports of customers goods shipped.
Coordinated with overseas offices by sharing customers details of the goods being transported this helped customers to collect their goods on time.
Responded to all customer queries on time and with efficiency.
Streamlined business processes for collection of goods from customer’s premises and coordinated drivers using transport allocation models on routes to use which reduced the business costs by 30%.
Coordinated language translation for the business as most of its customers are from the East African region with my prowess in both the local languages from the region and English. This helped the company be able to reach out to most of its customers and the customers were satisfied and liked my assistance together with how I helped my colleagues learn the languages.

Set up mobile phone-based money transfer services (MPESA, Airtel Money) APIs for customer payments into
the Vend app using Flask,Python and SQL skills. This helped customers to pay for their orders via the mobile phone
based money transfers which increased transactions volumes by 60%.
Designed the front end of the Vend application using Figma, React, HTML and CSS which increased customer user experience

Developed a sales tracker dashboard using MS Excel which was getting reports from the company’s underwriting system. This helped the business achieve a 20% sales growth and automated the prior processes which were done manually.
Led premium allocation process of unallocated premiums for prior periods which led to 20% of improvement
in revenue recognition by the company. I liaised with the Treasury Departments and Premium Administrations
Department to bank statements and premium debtors reports respectively and this halved the amount of
unallocated premiums.

I got promoted to a Unit Assistant role which entailed coordinating all underwriters and sales agents in the company due to my outstanding performance at the branch.
Spearheaded the team that redesigned the underwriting manual to better assess risks for the underwriting process recommended the addition of more questions to the applications forms which improved the quality of business underwritten and increased its gross profit commission of the company by 30%.
• Improved customer retention and the amount of premiums on medical and motor insurance by sending out
renewal notices on time to client and providing client with information about other company’s products. This
led to overall growth of our branch premiums of both new and renewal business by 20% and 10% respectively.

I was able to meet my sales targets and got an award and recognition.
Roles
Sales and marketing.
Creating customer awareness of CIC Insurance products.
Relationships management with existing clients.
Sell life assurance to prospective and existing individual and corporate clients.

Underwrote insurance products and did claims analysis of customers in liaison with Insurance companies.
Conducted customer awareness surveys on the insurance products penetration that helped the business improve their approach in reaching out to more clients in the area which grew the revenue of the business by 15%.
